name: Paycheck Reality Check
tagline: Reads a pay stub line by line and drafts the letter if it falls short
description: Paste in a pay stub and it works through it line by line, building a worksheet that shows what each deduction and rate should be without inventing numbers it cannot back. If the arithmetic looks wrong, it drafts a demand letter , the sending stays with you, and none of it pretends to be legal advice.
author: AlexFCHF
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
